column1: # My Pokemon Ranch -- renderable Pokemon-model ("Pii") roster
# 651 slots x 0x20 bytes each: { char* name_M, char* name_F, f32 scale, f32 size, u32 flags, u16, u16, u32 }.
# Model names (romaji) live in a blob at 0x8063B228, in National Dex order.
# NOTE: the model-table INDEX below is NOT the Pokemon's species number -- gender
#   variants (_M/_F) and forms each take their own slot, and 173 slots are placeholders
#   (name ptr -> 0x807Cxxxx) for species with no dedicated ranch model. Arceus fills 17
#   slots (632-648); the two eggs are 649 (TAMAGO_NORMAL) and 650 (TAMAGO_MANAFI).
# The talent_pt pokemon_level/met_location fields are SPECIES numbers, not these indices.
